intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both offer {{course}} programmes in {{cityA}}, but they are very different campuses. This page compares recorded fees and the one placement row we hold, using official sites opened in {{year}}.
Azim Premji University vs Bangalore City College is a specialist public-policy and education university against a smaller private college. The subjects on this page are not identical.

sections.heading: Azim Premji University vs Bangalore City College for MA: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Azim Premji University if you want an MA in education, development practice, public policy or local governance, with recorded tuition of ₹60,000 a year, plus a separate hostel head of ₹1.10 lakh a year.

Choose Bangalore City College if you want a general Master of Arts at the recorded tuition of ₹5,250 a year, with a 2023 record of ₹3 lakh average and ₹4 lakh highest, after you confirm the official notice and the exact subject.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what to watch
paragraphs: For Azim Premji University we hold ₹60,000 as tuition for one year on the listed MA programmes, and ₹1.10 lakh as a hostel year head.
Do not add the hostel amount as if it were tuition, and do not ignore it if you will live on campus. Confirm the official notice for the current totals.
For Bangalore City College we hold ₹5,250 as MA tuition for one year. That is a year figure, not a confirmed two-year official total.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Bangalore City College has a 2023 MA row of ₹3 lakh average and ₹4 lakh highest. That is a historical record, not a promise.

Azim Premji University has no MA placement row in our table. Many of its graduates look at education, development and public-policy work. Ask the university for a recent outcomes note rather than expecting an MBA-style package.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: No entrance exam is mapped on this page. Azim Premji University typically runs its own postgraduate admissions process. Follow the official form for each campus.

Azim Premji University lists named MA programmes in education, development, public policy and local governance. Bangalore City College has a generic Master of Arts row, so confirm the subject before you apply.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both are recorded in Bangalore, Karnataka, so the city is the same. The campuses and student communities are not interchangeable.
Visit the department you would join. A public-policy or education MA and a generic MA are different academic settings.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Pick Azim Premji University if the listed education or public-policy MA is the degree you want, and you have budgeted tuition and hostel from the official notice.
Pick Bangalore City College if a general MA at the recorded ₹5,250 year tuition fits your plan, after you confirm the subject and the official fee.
Do not treat these as interchangeable Master's programmes just because both are in Bangalore.
